description: Source code for managing IPv6 Router Advertisement settings, including interface configurations, options, and parameters, with functions for getting, setting, adding, and deleting configuration objects and parameters.

methods.name: radv_get_option_value
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specific option from a UCI section, returning '1' if present, '0' otherwise.

methods.name: radv_set_option_value
methods.description: Sets or unsets a specific option in a UCI section based on a boolean input.

methods.name: browseRouterAdvertisementInterfaceSettingInst
methods.description: Iterates over router advertisement interface settings, creating instances for each non-ignored section.

methods.name: browseRouterAdvertisementInterfaceSettingOptionInst
methods.description: Iterates over DNS options within a specific interface setting, creating instances for each.

methods.name: addObjRouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting
methods.description: Creates a new router advertisement interface setting object with default values.

methods.name: delObjRouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting
methods.description: Deletes specified interface setting objects, either individually or all.

methods.name: addObjRouterAdvertisementInterfaceSettingOption
methods.description: Creates a new option within an interface setting.

methods.name: delObjRouterAdvertisementInterfaceSettingOption
methods.description: Deletes specific options within an interface setting, either individually or all.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisement_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of the router advertisement feature.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisement_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable status of the router advertisement feature.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisement_InterfaceSettingNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of interface setting entries.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_Enable
methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of a specific interface setting.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable status of a specific interface setting.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_Status
methods.description: Retrieves the status (enabled/disabled) of a specific interface setting.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_Alias
methods.description: Retrieves the alias of a specific interface setting.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias of a specific interface setting.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_Interface
methods.description: Retrieves the interface reference for a specific setting.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_Interface
methods.description: Sets the interface reference for a specific setting, validating allowed objects.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_Prefixes
methods.description: Retrieves IPv6 prefixes associated with an interface.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_MaxRtrAdvInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the maximum router advertisement interval.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_MaxRtrAdvInterval
methods.description: Sets the maximum router advertisement interval.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_MinRtrAdvInterval
methods.description: Retrieves the minimum router advertisement interval.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_MinRtrAdvInterval
methods.description: Sets the minimum router advertisement interval.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvDefaultLifetime
methods.description: Retrieves the default lifetime for router advertisements.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvDefaultLifetime
methods.description: Sets the default lifetime for router advertisements.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvManagedFlag
methods.description: Retrieves the managed-config flag status.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvManagedFlag
methods.description: Sets the managed-config flag.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvOtherConfigFlag
methods.description: Retrieves the other-config flag status.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvOtherConfigFlag
methods.description: Sets the other-config flag.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvMobileAgentFlag
methods.description: Retrieves the home-agent flag status.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvMobileAgentFlag
methods.description: Sets the home-agent flag.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvPreferredRouterFlag
methods.description: Retrieves the router preference (High/Low/Medium).

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvPreferredRouterFlag
methods.description: Sets the router preference.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvLinkMTU
methods.description: Retrieves the link MTU value.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvLinkMTU
methods.description: Sets the link MTU value.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvReachableTime
methods.description: Retrieves the reachable time for advertisements.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvReachableTime
methods.description: Sets the reachable time.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvRetransTimer
methods.description: Retrieves the retransmission timer.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvRetransTimer
methods.description: Sets the retransmission timer.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvCurHopLimit
methods.description: Retrieves the current hop limit.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_AdvCurHopLimit
methods.description: Sets the current hop limit.

methods.name: get_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSetting_OptionNumberOfEntries
methods.description: Returns the number of options configured.

methods.description: Retrieves the enable status of a specific option.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSettingOption_Enable
methods.description: Sets the enable status of a specific option.

methods.description: Retrieves the alias of a specific option.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSettingOption_Alias
methods.description: Sets the alias of a specific option.

methods.description: Retrieves the tag value for an option.

methods.name: set_RouterAdvertisementInterfaceSettingOption_Tag
methods.description: Sets the tag value for an option.
